title: Status-for-sovereignty compact and the white-dominant selector state

parent_hypothesis.relationship: bounded child hypothesis that supplies a specific status, racial-order, and political-economy transmission model without changing DCA-H01

working_proposition: A vertically stratified coalition can exchange mass status restoration for expanded executive and founder-capital sovereignty: grievance and nested superiority legitimate the subordination of independent counterpower; public authority then controls selection, capital, procurement, infrastructure, and institutional succession; conditional multiracial incorporation legitimates the selector; and counterfactual foreclosure makes the preferred order appear meritocratic without requiring a central conspiracy or uniform private intent.
negative_constitution: No outside actor may convert contradiction, patterned outcome, affected-party evidence, or an alternative into a binding pause, correction, substitution, or value claim unless the protected center admits the challenge on terms the center controls.

racial_order_hypothesis.label: white_dominant_conditionally_multiracial
racial_order_hypothesis.definition: An institutional order may remain white-dominant when rules, burdens, classifications, defaults, remedies, and status allocations preserve a racial hierarchy while permitting sincere and sometimes powerful non-White incorporation on terms that validate the selector and do not create independent collective counterpower.
must_test: public contribution and private residual rights
racial_order_hypothesis.forbidden_shortcut: Demography, rhetoric, disparity, or individual success alone establishes the racial order.

patriotism_discriminator.question: When does patriotism or national-security language express ordinary collective purpose, and when does it legitimate a status hierarchy, narrow admissible knowledge, remove counterpower, or convert public authority into protected private control?
negative_controls: civic patriotism with equal standing and robust dissent
lawful industrial policy with complete denominators and public recovery
national-security action with bounded expiry and independent review
diverse coalition with effective collective counterpower
patriotism_discriminator.forbidden_inference: Patriotic or national-security rhetoric alone proves white supremacy, fascism, coordination, or coercive operation.

four_gate_discriminator.name: status_and_deservingness
four_gate_discriminator.question: Who is assigned honor, authenticity, productivity, loyalty, dependency, danger, contamination, or undeservingness?
four_gate_discriminator.required_record: bounded status classification, audience, comparator, date, and claimed injury
four_gate_discriminator.forbidden_inference: insult or disagreement alone proves institutional hierarchy

four_gate_discriminator.name: epistemic_admissibility
four_gate_discriminator.question: Whose knowledge, contradiction, patterned outcome, or institutional expertise may count before the problem and option set are fixed?
four_gate_discriminator.required_record: qualified knower or affected party, evidence, reclassification, and admissibility rule
four_gate_discriminator.forbidden_inference: expert disagreement alone proves a ceiling-conversion event

four_gate_discriminator.name: material_conversion
four_gate_discriminator.question: Who controls the employment, publication, appointment, funding, procurement, data, accreditation, legal, or platform gate that makes the classification operative?
four_gate_discriminator.required_record: authority basis, exact instrument, selected and rejected denominator, and consequence
four_gate_discriminator.forbidden_inference: formal authority or policy preference alone proves abuse

four_gate_discriminator.name: correction_monopoly
four_gate_discriminator.question: Who can preserve evidence, stay action, shift the burden, reverse the decision, sustain an alternative, substitute the system, co-govern, exit, or recover value?
four_gate_discriminator.required_record: formal and practical remedy, timing, cost, durability, and observed outcome
four_gate_discriminator.forbidden_inference: formal process or criticism alone proves effective counterpower

dimensions.label: Status grievance and esteem restoration
dimensions.question: What lost honor, disrespect, humiliation, betrayal, or denied recognition is claimed, and what status return is offered?
dimensions.required_observation: speaker, audience, claimed injury, promised recognition, and material or symbolic return

dimensions.label: Nested superiority and deservingness
dimensions.question: Which accepted rung is placed above which designated lower rung, and through what public category?
dimensions.required_observation: explicit or operational superiority relation, category, gate, and consequence

dimensions.label: Conditional multiracial incorporation
dimensions.question: Who is admitted, on what terms, with what actual authority, and can incorporation generate independent collective counterpower?
dimensions.required_observation: complete composition, selection criteria, governance rights, outcomes, and challenge capacity

dimensions.label: Epistemic reclassification
dimensions.question: How are contrary expertise, affected-party evidence, or patterned outcomes recoded as ideology, capture, disloyalty, excuse, process failure, or insufficient commitment?
dimensions.required_observation: qualified source, contradiction, before/after explanation, and admissibility effect

dimensions.label: Counterpower subordination
dimensions.question: Which court, regulator, civil servant, scientist, journalist, union, university, board, inspector, or affected-party body loses binding power?
dimensions.required_observation: checking function, exact removal or weakening instrument, and before/after authority

dimensions.label: Selector and option-set control
dimensions.question: Who defines merit, readiness, culture, risk, seriousness, eligibility, and the complete option universe?
dimensions.required_observation: selector, criteria, denominator, selected and rejected rows, and review process

dimensions.label: Public conversion and market creation
dimensions.question: Which appointment, law, procurement, loan, guarantee, grant, test range, accreditation, standard, or public demand scales the selected capacity?
dimensions.required_observation: exact public instrument, public risk or contribution, private contribution, and performance record

dimensions.label: Private residual rights and sovereignty
dimensions.question: Who retains equity, revenue, IP, data position, governance, operating knowledge, strategic market position, or contract options after public conversion?
dimensions.required_observation: rights instrument, beneficiary, public recovery terms, and causal chronology

dimensions.label: Counterfactual foreclosure and legitimacy seal
dimensions.question: Which alternatives lose the chance to accumulate comparable evidence, and how are selected success or diverse winners used to legitimate the gate?
dimensions.required_observation: initial alternative universe, support differential, evidence opportunity, later necessity or neutrality claim

dimensions.label: Practical correction, substitution, exit, and value recovery
dimensions.question: Can affected people or an independent body stop, correct, reverse, substitute, co-govern, exit, or recover public value in practice?
dimensions.required_observation: notice, evidence access, stay, remedy, transition, cost, observed outcome, and succession durability

cross_system_join.K0: status and identity classifications supply priors that determine who is permitted to count as a knower before C1 and C2
cross_system_join.DCA_H01: provides distributed, stigmergic convergence mechanisms without a master list or common-purpose presumption
cross_system_join.Clifford_C1_C7: tracks option-set formation, public conversion, control architecture, dependency, residual value, and reversibility
cross_system_join.M04B: tests doctrine, capital, selection, public gates, personnel routing, deployment, residual rights, and counterpower as separate organs
cross_system_join.M05_S14: tests bounded ceiling-conversion events rather than personality or ideology scores
cross_system_join.M05_S15: tests whether protected centers reserve safeguards, review, exceptions, remedy, or exit that affected people do not receive
cross_system_join.POOF: may project only reviewed records and cannot convert political interpretation into evidence
cross_system_join.Answerable_Power: supplies the empirical answer ladder from representation through binding correction, substitution, co-governance, and value recovery

alternative_explanations: ordinary civic patriotism and national solidarity
ineffective or unlawful DEI implementation corrected through neutral performance rules
lawful strategic industrial policy with transparent selection and public recovery
independent local incentives without shared negative constitution
mission urgency with bounded expiry and independent review
genuine multiracial coalition with effective collective power
competitive market success with comparable alternatives and proportionate private risk
documentation gaps rather than deliberate concealment
falsifiers: patriotic frames repeatedly coexist with equal epistemic standing and robust institutional dissent
unsanctioned qualified knowers and affected parties retain standing after contradiction
selection denominators, criteria, public support, failures, and nonselected alternatives remain visible
non-White incorporation produces durable independent agenda, veto, remedy, and redistribution power
patterned outcomes can trigger binding review without proof of secret intent
public strategic-capital programs preserve broad competition, proportionate risk, public rights, and observed recovery
counterpower can pause action before consequence and survives leadership succession
practical substitution and public operation work without the protected center
private residual value is proportionate and does not depend materially on gates beneficiaries shaped
the alleged racial or capital conversion disappears under exact instrument, comparator, and outcome review
